decision: R1251/R1253/R1254: begin owns heap creation, NTSRV registration and session activation before original TimerInit. The completion jump returns into the still-live main frame and both successful startup paths share finish. Bootstrap failure already performs its own cleanup. Native CRT return would bypass the shared finish. R1252: removing the shadow registry include compiles but rebinds all three CpuEnv operations to native NT, bypassing the selected package overlay.
